introduction: Hawaiʻi weatherization applications belong with the agency serving your county. HCAP is the Honolulu provider; residents of other islands should use the state’s county-agency directory.
description: Hawaiʻi weatherization applications belong with the agency serving your county. HCAP is the Honolulu provider; residents of other islands should use the state’s county-agency

sections.who: The program serves eligible low-income households and prioritizes specified households, including older people, people with disabilities, families with children and homes with high energy burdens. The provider checks eligibility and the home’s suitability.
sections.get: An assessment identifies appropriate efficiency measures and energy-conservation advice. Possible measures include lighting, water-saving fixtures and selected efficient equipment; the home assessment determines the approved work.
sections.docs:
• Prepare income and household information.
  • Have your utility records and address available.
  • Ask about ownership or tenancy records and any required owner permission.
sections.apply:
1. Find the county provider

    Use the Office of Community Services directory for Honolulu, Hawaiʻi, Maui or Kauaʻi.

  2. Request intake

    Honolulu residents can contact HCAP’s weatherization program. Confirm application availability and the provider’s checklist.

  3. Arrange the home assessment

    Explain energy problems and follow the provider’s audit and scheduling instructions.
sections.after: Confirm the approved scope before work starts. Ask the provider about timing, access and any safety issue discovered during assessment.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using State weatherization eligibility and county directory, HCAP weatherization program. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The state lists separate county agencies. Use the provider serving your county.
It provides selected efficiency services and education, rather than an unrestricted cash payment.
No automatic replacement is promised. Measures depend on eligibility, the assessment and program approval.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
